title: Match Maker
description:
A mod that improves multiplayer convenience and adds automatic matchmaking.
Match multiplayer lobbies based on community name / language / ascension / player count / installed mods, or use quick rehosting and kick/ban features.

Doesn't affect gameplay, so you can freely play with people who don't have it installed.

https://github.com/TalkingHand/sts2-matchmaker
changeNote: Dread fixes: Dread is always played at Ascension 10, so the ascension option is hidden for it and Dread rooms no longer get split by ascension. Also, if a vanilla lobby joined through the automatic lobby list turns out to be a different run type than the one you searched for (e.g. a Blitz or Dread room when you wanted Standard), you now leave it and keep searching.
